          Source

          Help

          Add questions

          Replacing this file keeps your saved data. Best way: your own question file.

          1. Get the sample file below. Open it in a plain text editor, not Word.
          2. Edit the words between quotes. Keep every quote, comma, bracket and brace. To add one, copy a whole block from { to }, paste it after the last, and add a comma between blocks.
          3. A quote inside your words is written \".
          4. Save as .json. On the start screen, Choose your file. It is checked first.

          {
  "questionText": "Which document authorizes a project?",
  "choices": ["Project charter", "Risk register", "Status report", "Issue log"],
  "correctAnswer": 0,
  "explanation": "The charter formally authorizes the project.",
  "time": 60
}

          correctAnswer counts from 0. time (seconds) is optional. optionExplanations (one text per choice) is optional. A file is {"topic": "My set", "questions": [ blocks ]}, up to 5 MB. Your file is not kept: choose it again each time.

          Fix a built-in question

          1. Copy this file first.
          2. Open it in a plain text editor. Search a few words of the question. It sits in one long line, the content block.
          3. Edit only words between the backslash-quote pairs. Keep every backslash, quote, comma and bracket. Use an apostrophe, not a quote.
          4. Raise "dataVersion" and the date at the block start. Save. Reload. Check the footer and the question count.

          Edit nothing outside that block. An edited question starts as new in your review schedule. Content ?, ?. Source: ?

          Colour

          Search --hue. The first match sits in the opening html tag. Change the number (0 to 359) to move the accent colour. All four looks follow it.

          Saved here

          Answers and flags stay in this tab and end on close or reload. Look is saved as pmquiz.look. A review log is saved as pmquiz.reviewlog only if you tick Save progress. It holds question codes, times, results and ratings, never question text. Nothing is sent.

          Export

          Export on the start screen downloads the log as JSON. Import reads it back (needs Save progress ticked). A bad file is refused whole. Print the review sheet to keep a result.

          Delete

          Delete log on the start screen asks for a second tap. This clears the Look choice:

          Keys

          1-4 or A-D answer. F flag. N or Enter next. P back (study only). Esc cancels a confirm. In review, 1-4 rate recall.

          Timer

          Pauses while Help or Licences is open.

          Review schedule

          With Save progress: missed or timed out = Again, flagged = Hard. The second box adds correct answers as Good. Due dates use the FSRS-5 default parameters (target 0.9), whole days, no random fuzz.

          Drill

          10 questions from one domain: missed first, then unseen. Any domain can be picked.

          Explanations

          Built-in papers explain the correct answer only. Your file may add optionExplanations.

          Limits

          A high score does not predict an exam result. Questions are unsourced and not official. Check gaps against a current primary reference.

          Licences

          One embedded font (OFL-1.1). No libraries. Scheduler written from the published FSRS-5 description.

          Source Serif 4

          v4.005, github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif. Copyright 2014 - 2023 Adobe, Reserved Font Name "Source". Subset renamed "Subset Serif".

          Question banks

          1,774 questions bundled as data. No source or licence recorded.
